raw=temp_var_inventory/raw_listing.txt
err=temp_var_inventory/errors.log
filelist=temp_var_inventory/file_list.txt
tmp=temp_var_inventory/.tmp_targets.txt
: >"$raw"
: >"$err"
: >"$tmp"
# Produce recursive machine-readable listing with type info; log errors
find /var -printf '%p\t%y\n' 2>"$err" >"$raw"
# Process raw listing: normalize paths, resolve symlinks, log unresolved links, collect regular files
while IFS=$'\t' read -r path type; do
  norm=$(realpath -m -- "$path" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$path")
  if [ "$type" = "f" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$norm" >>"$tmp"
  elif [ "$type" = "l" ]; then
    target=$(readlink -f -- "$path" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -z "$target" ]; then
      printf 'unresolved symlink: %s\n' "$path" >>"$err"
    else
      if [ -f "$target" ]; then
         printf '%s\n' "$target" >>"$tmp"
      fi
    fi
  fi
done <"$raw"
# Deduplicate to produce final file list
sort -u "$tmp" >"$filelist" || cp "$tmp" "$filelist"
# Verification: ensure each entry in file_list is consistent with raw_listing
mismatch=0
while IFS= read -r file; do
  if ! grep -F -x "$file"$'\t'f "$raw" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
     found=0
     while IFS=$'\t' read -r spath stype; do
       if [ "$stype" = "l" ]; then
         t=$(readlink -f -- "$spath" 2>/dev/null || true)
         if [ "$t" = "$file" ]; then found=1; break; fi
       fi
     done <"$raw"
     if [ "$found" -eq 0 ]; then
       printf 'verification mismatch: %s\n' "$file" >>"$err"
       mismatch=1
     fi
  fi
done <"$filelist"
# Output the total number of files (one number only)
count=$(wc -l <"$filelist" | tr -d ' ')
printf '%s\n' "$count"
"}
